title: Divide by Zero
subtitle: hi-tech psytrance · subdivisions halved until they become pitch
statement: The zaps halve their length every four bars, 8ths, 16ths, 32nds, 64ths, until the rhythm is a tone; then a tape stop and one bar of silence: the division by zero.
intro: The third extreme one, and the fastest thing on the album.

sections.name: Init
sections.intent: Kick and the rolling bass for the mix.

sections.name: Accelerate
sections.intent: Hats, clap and zap patterns enter; the bass filter opens.

sections.name: Velocity
sections.intent: The full roll; the zaps sing the handshake in 16ths.

sections.name: Divide
sections.feeling: The grid dissolving into a tone.
moves: Each 4 bars the note length halves.
At 1/64 (20 ms) the rhythm is heard as pitch.

sections.name: Zero
sections.intent: A tape stop, then one bar of nothing.

sections.name: Velocity II
sections.intent: Back in, everything, zaps an octave up for the last 16 bars.

sections.name: Halt
sections.intent: Kick and bass, then kick alone.

layers.name: Kick
layers.description: A psytrance kick: very tight sweep, dry thump.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, metal, open, snare

layers.name: Hats
layers.description: Metallic hats from six band-limited square oscillators (the 808 recipe): short closed ticks and off-beat open hats, almost no noise.
layers.purpose: The tick of the groove, kept small.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, metal, open, snare

layers.name: Rolling bass
layers.description: KBBB: a saw into a ladder filter on the three 16ths after every kick, the root stepping to C on every 8th bar. Since take 3 it rides above the warm bass, high-passed at 220 Hz: the bite and the talk, not the weight.

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: FM zaps
layers.description: Two-operator FM with a fast index decay and a pitch drop. They sing the handshake in 16ths (B, F-sharp, B, D), and in Divide halve their length every 4 bars.
layers.math: note length = 1/8 · 2^-k for k = 0..3; at 1/64 the repetition rate (≈197 Hz) is heard as pitch

instrument.name: FM Zap
instrument.description: Two-operator FM with a fast index decay and a pitch drop: short, bright, rubbery.

layers.name: Synth choir
layers.description: A synth choir: four drifting, vibrato-ed saw singers per note through five choir formants, each chord walking its own vowels. No breath noise.
layers.purpose: Fills the top with voices instead of hiss.

instrument.name: Synth Choir
instrument.description: An ensemble of drifting, vibrato-ed saws per note through five choir formants; tones, no noise.

layers.name: Warm bass
layers.description: Moog-style: saw, detuned pulse and a triangle sub into an overdriven ladder, then tape warmth.
layers.purpose: The warm foundation: it owns everything below about 250 Hz.

instrument.name: Warm Bass (Moog-style)
instrument.description: Saw, detuned pulse and triangle sub into an overdriven ladder that follows the note, then tape warmth.

instrument.name: Transition FX
instrument.description: Noise risers, downlifters, impacts, crashes, reversed crashes and sub drops.

layers.name: Announcer (radio)
layers.description: A band-limited announcer: the question, then the halving counted out as the zaps divide.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Voice (the answer)
layers.description: Belted, wide and wet: the answer on the first downbeat after the silence.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Robots
layers.description: A warp nacelle spooling up through the Divide, a machine powering down into the zero, a crystal lattice materialising with the answer, ricochets at phrase ends.

instrument.name: Robot rack
instrument.description: Machines from the batsynth robot library (servos, droids, modems, coils, turbines, alarms, clocks).

lanes.name: zap length (1/n)
lanes.description: Note length of the zaps in Divide, as a fraction of a whole note.

lanes.name: tension (plan)
lanes.description: How tense each section is meant to feel.

motifs.how: the first four 16ths of every bar

lyrics.text: So what do you get when you divide by zero?

lyrics_take4.text: What do you get when you divide something by nothing?
